questions.question: Konteyner va virtual mashina farqi?
questions.explanation: Konteyner — o'ralgan jarayon, 'kichik VM' emas. Oqibatlari: yadro umumiy (security chegarasi zaifroq — shuning uchun ko'p tenantli muhitda gVisor/Firecracker), host yadrosiga bog'liqlik (Linux image Windows yadrosida ishlamaydi). Image — qatlamli fayl tizimi, konteyner esa shu image'dan ishga tushgan jarayon.

questions.question: Nega har kod o'zgarishida build 5 daqiqa ketadi? Tuzatish?
questions.snippet:
FROM node:20
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
RUN npm run build
CMD ["node", "dist/main.js"]
questions.explanation: Docker qatlamlarni keshlaydi: qatlam inputi o'zgarmasa qayta bajarilmaydi. To'g'ri tartib: kam o'zgaradigan narsa yuqorida. Yana: .dockerignore (node_modules, .git), multi-stage build bilan yakuniy image'da faqat dist va production bog'liqliklar, root bo'lmagan user, aniq versiyali base image (node:20.11-alpine, latest emas).

questions.question: Image va container farqi nima?
questions.explanation: Image — o'zgarmas, qatlamli shablon (read-only layer'lar). Container — image'ning ishga tushgan nusxasi: ustiga yoziladigan qatlam + izolyatsiya qilingan jarayon.

questions.question: Dockerfile'dagi asosiy instruksiyalar: FROM, RUN, COPY, CMD, ENTRYPOINT, EXPOSE, ENV — har biri nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: FROM — asos image; RUN — build paytida buyruq (yangi layer); COPY — fayl ko'chirish; CMD — default argument; ENTRYPOINT — doimiy bajariladigan dastur; EXPOSE — hujjat (portni ochmaydi); ENV — muhit o'zgaruvchisi.

questions.question: `docker run -p 8080:80`, `-v`, `-e`, `--rm`, `-d` flaglari nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: -p host:container port mapping; -v volume/bind mount; -e env; --rm to'xtaganda o'chirish; -d fonda ishlatish.

questions.question: Volume, bind mount va tmpfs farqi?
questions.explanation: Volume — Docker boshqaradigan papka (/var/lib/docker/volumes), portativ; bind mount — hostdagi aniq yo'l; tmpfs — RAM'da, vaqtinchalik.

questions.question: Docker registry bilan ishlash: login, tag, push, pull. Private registry?
questions.explanation: Image registry'da saqlanadi (Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR, Harbor). Nom: registry/namespace/repo:tag. docker tag bilan nom beriladi, docker push yuboradi.

questions.question: `docker ps`, `images`, `logs`, `exec`, `rm`, `rmi`, `system prune` — asosiy buyruqlar nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: ps — container'lar; images — image'lar; logs — stdout/stderr; exec — ishlab turgan container ichida buyruq; rm/rmi — o'chirish; system prune — keraksiz narsalarni tozalash.

questions.question: Multi-stage build nima va nega kerak?
questions.explanation: Bitta Dockerfile'da bir nechta FROM: birinchi bosqichda kompilyator bilan build, oxirgisiga faqat binary ko'chiriladi. Image kichik, xavfsiz, build tool'lar production'ga tushmaydi.

questions.question: `ARG` va `ENV` farqi? Secret'ni `ARG` bilan berish nega xavfli?
questions.explanation: ARG — faqat build vaqtida mavjud; ENV — build va container ishlayotganda ham. ARG qiymati image tarixida (`docker history`) ko'rinadi, shuning uchun secret uchun yaramaydi — `--secret` mount ishlatiladi.

questions.question: `COPY` va `ADD` farqi? Qaysi birini ishlatish kerak?
questions.explanation: Ikkalasi fayl ko'chiradi. ADD qo'shimcha: URL'dan yuklaydi va lokal tar arxivni avtomatik ochadi — kutilmagan xatti-harakat. Default COPY; ADD faqat tar ochish kerak bo'lsa.

questions.question: OverlayFS va Copy-on-Write: image layer'lari container'da qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Image layer'lari read-only, ustiga har container uchun yupqa yoziladigan layer qo'yiladi. Faylni o'zgartirish uni yuqori layer'ga nusxalaydi (CoW). Container o'chsa — yozilganlar yo'qoladi; doimiy data volume'da.

questions.question: Production image hajmini kamaytirishning eng samarali yo'li?
questions.explanation: Katta image — sekin deploy, sekin autoscaling, katta hujum yuzasi. Qo'shimcha: slim/alpine yoki distroless base, RUN'larni birlashtirib cache'ni o'chirish (apt-get clean), .dockerignore. Go uchun yakuniy image scratch/distroless'da bir necha MB bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.question: Docker layer cache qanday ishlaydi va Dockerfile tartibi nega muhim?
questions.explanation: Har instruksiya layer; instruksiya va kirish fayllari o'zgarmasa cache ishlatiladi. Bitta layer o'zgarsa undan keyingilar hammasi qayta quriladi — kam o'zgaradiganlarni yuqoriga qo'y.

questions.question: CMD va ENTRYPOINT farqi; shell form va exec form?
questions.explanation: ENTRYPOINT — doimiy dastur, CMD — unga default argument. Exec form (JSON array) jarayonni PID 1 qiladi va signal oladi; shell form /bin/sh -c orqali ishlaydi, SIGTERM ilovaga yetmaydi.

questions.question: Docker network turlari: bridge, host, none, overlay. Container'lar bir-birini qanday topadi?
questions.explanation: bridge — default, NAT; host — host network stack; none — tarmoqsiz; overlay — ko'p host (Swarm). User-defined bridge'da Docker embedded DNS (127.0.0.11) container nomini resolve qiladi.

questions.question: `docker stop` va `docker kill` farqi? Restart policy'lar?
questions.explanation: stop — SIGTERM, timeout (10s) keyin SIGKILL; kill — darhol SIGKILL (yoki --signal). Restart: no, on-failure[:N], always, unless-stopped.

questions.question: Container ichida nima bo'layotganini qanday debug qilasan?
questions.explanation: docker logs -f, docker exec -it sh, docker inspect, docker stats, docker events, docker top; distroless bo'lsa docker debug yoki --pid/--network bilan sidecar.

questions.question: Docker HEALTHCHECK qanday ishlaydi va nima uchun kerak?
questions.explanation: Container ichida davriy buyruq ishlatadi; holat starting/healthy/unhealthy. Compose depends_on va Swarm rolling update shundan foydalanadi. Oddiy Docker unhealthy container'ni o'zi restart qilmaydi.

questions.question: Container resurs limitlari: `--memory`, `--cpus`, `--pids-limit`. Limit oshsa nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Cgroups orqali. Memory oshsa — kernel OOM killer jarayonni o'ldiradi (exit 137, OOMKilled=true). CPU limit — throttling (sekinlashadi, o'lmaydi). pids-limit — fork bomb'dan himoya.

questions.question: Docker logging: log qayerga yoziladi, disk to'lib qolishining oldini qanday olasan?
questions.explanation: Default json-file driver /var/lib/docker/containers/<id>/<id>-json.log ga, rotatsiyasiz yozadi. max-size/max-file qo'y yoki local/journald/fluentd driver ishlat. Ilova stdout'ga yozishi kerak.

questions.question: `docker system df` 80 GB ko'rsatyapti. Disk nima bilan to'ladi va qanday tozalaysan?
questions.explanation: Dangling image'lar, to'xtagan container'lar, ishlatilmagan volume'lar, build cache, katta log fayllar. prune buyruqlari bilan tanlab tozalanadi.

questions.question: `docker build` context nima, `.dockerignore` nega kerak?
questions.explanation: Context — build'ga yuboriladigan papka (odatda .). Hammasi daemon'ga uzatiladi. .dockerignore keraksiz/maxfiy fayllarni chiqarib tashlaydi: build tez, cache barqaror, secret image'ga tushmaydi.

questions.question: Container ishga tushib darhol to'xtaydi (`Exited (0)` yoki `Exited (1)`). Sabablari va debug?
questions.explanation: Container asosiy process (PID 1) tugashi bilan to'xtaydi. Exit 0 — process ishini tugatdi (masalan foreground'da emas, daemon rejimiga o'tdi); exit 1 — app xatosi. docker logs, inspect, entrypoint'ni override qilib ichiga kirish.

questions.question: Container ichidagi app `localhost:5432` dagi DB'ga ulana olmayapti, host'da esa ishlaydi. Nega?
questions.explanation: Container o'z network namespace'iga ega: uning localhost'i — container'ning o'zi, host emas. Compose/user network'da service nomi (`db:5432`), host'dagi servisga — `host.docker.internal` yoki host gateway IP.

questions.question: Image'dagi zaifliklarni qanday topasiz va CI'da qanday to'xtatasiz?
questions.explanation: Trivy/Grype bilan image scan; CI'da HIGH/CRITICAL topilsa pipeline fail. Kamaytirish: minimal base (distroless/alpine), muntazam rebuild, ishlatilmaydigan paketlarni olib tashlash, non-root.

questions.question: Zombie process nima va container'da nega `tini` / `--init` kerak?
questions.explanation: Container'da app PID 1 bo'ladi. PID 1 orphan child'larni `wait()` qilmasa zombie to'planadi va SIGTERM'ning default handler'i yo'q. tini kichik init: signalni uzatadi va zombie'larni yig'adi.

questions.question: `/var/run/docker.sock`'ni container'ga mount qilish va `--privileged` nega xavfli?
questions.explanation: Docker socket'ga kirish = host'da root: istalgan container'ni host / bilan mount qilib ishga tushirish mumkin. --privileged barcha capability va device'larni beradi, izolyatsiya deyarli yo'q. Ikkalasi ham container escape.

questions.question: Docker'ni ishlatmasdan CI'da (Kubernetes runner'da) image qanday build qilinadi? Kaniko, BuildKit, Buildah?
questions.explanation: Docker-in-Docker privileged talab qiladi. Kaniko — Dockerfile'ni userspace'da, daemon'siz build qiladi; BuildKit rootless rejimi; Buildah/Podman — daemon'siz. Hammasi OCI image chiqaradi.

questions.question: Container'ni read-only rejimda qanday ishga tushirasiz va nega?
questions.explanation: `--read-only` root filesystem'ni faqat o'qishga qiladi: hujumchi binary yoza olmaydi, app tasodifan konteyner ichiga data yozmaydi. Yozish kerak joylar — tmpfs yoki volume.

questions.question: Go servis uchun production image: qaysi qurilish to'g'ri?
questions.explanation: Toolchain'li image: 1GB+ hajm, ko'p CVE, ichida kompilyator va shell — hujum yuzasi. Distroless/scratch bilan bir necha o'n MB. Eslatmalar: `scratch`da TLS uchun `ca-certificates` va zone ma'lumotlari ko'chiriladi, `CGO_ENABLED=0` static bo'lishi uchun, layer keshi uchun `go mod download` alohida qatlamda.

questions.question: Docker container izolyatsiyasi qanday qurilgan va u VM'dek xavfsizmi?
questions.explanation: Namespace (pid, net, mnt, uts, ipc, user), cgroups (resurs), capabilities, seccomp, AppArmor/SELinux. Kernel umumiy — kernel exploit host'ni oladi, VM'dek kuchli chegara emas.

questions.question: Docker arxitekturasi: docker CLI, dockerd, containerd, runc qanday bog'langan?
questions.explanation: CLI REST API orqali dockerd'ga; dockerd containerd'ga (gRPC); containerd shim orqali runc'ni chaqiradi; runc OCI spec bo'yicha namespace/cgroup yaratib jarayonni ishga tushiradi va chiqadi.

questions.question: Image'ni tag bilan emas digest bilan pin qilish va image supply chain xavfsizligi?
questions.explanation: Tag o'zgaruvchan (latest qayta yoziladi), digest (sha256) o'zgarmas. Production: digest pin, imzolash (cosign), SBOM, vulnerability scan, minimal base image.

questions.question: Multi-arch image (amd64 + arm64) qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: docker buildx + BuildKit: --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64, natija bitta tag ostida manifest list. QEMU emulyatsiya sekin — Go'da GOARCH bilan cross-compile yoki native builder'lar tez.

questions.question: Rootless Docker va userns-remap nima? Qachon kerak?
questions.explanation: Container ichidagi root host'da oddiy UID'ga map qilinadi. Container escape bo'lsa ham host root olinmaydi. Kamchilik: <1024 port, ba'zi storage/network cheklovlari.

questions.question: Docker build CI'da sekin (har safar 10+ daqiqa). Qanday tezlashtirasiz?
questions.explanation: Layer tartibi (dependency avval, kod keyin), .dockerignore, BuildKit cache mount, CI'da remote cache (registry yoki gha), multi-stage parallel. O'lchash: build log'da qaysi qadam CACHED emas.

questions.question: Container `Exited (137)` bilan o'lyapti, log'da xato yo'q. Nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: 137 = 128+9 (SIGKILL). Ko'pincha cgroup OOM. `docker inspect` OOMKilled ni ko'r, limit vs real memory, runtime limitni biladimi (GOMEMLIMIT, MaxRAMPercentage).

questions.question: Container ichida DNS ishlamayapti (`Temporary failure in name resolution`), host'da ishlaydi. Sabab?
questions.explanation: Host /etc/resolv.conf 127.0.0.53 (systemd-resolved) — container'dan unga yetib bo'lmaydi, Docker 8.8.8.8 ga fallback qiladi, korporativ tarmoq uni bloklaydi. Fix: daemon.json "dns", yoki --dns.

questions.question: Docker o'rnatilgandan keyin ofis/VPN'dagi `172.17.x.x` serverlarga ulanib bo'lmay qoldi. Nega?
questions.explanation: docker0 bridge default 172.17.0.0/16 — route jadvalida ofis subnet'i bilan to'qnashdi, trafik bridge'ga ketyapti. Fix: daemon.json bip va default-address-pools bilan boshqa diapazon.

questions.question: `systemctl restart docker` yoki Docker update qilinganda prod'dagi barcha container'lar o'chdi. Qanday oldini olasan?
questions.explanation: Default'da dockerd o'lsa container'lar ham to'xtaydi. `"live-restore": true` — daemon restart vaqtida container'lar ishlashda davom etadi. Plus restart policy, maintenance oynasi.

questions.question: Image'dan secret (API key) chiqib qoldi: Dockerfile'da `COPY .env` keyin `RUN rm .env` qilingan edi. Nima bo'ldi va nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: Har RUN/COPY alohida layer — rm faqat keyingi layer'da yashiradi, eski layer'da fayl qoladi (`docker save`, `dive`). Darhol key'ni rotate qil, keyin BuildKit secret mount, .dockerignore.

questions.question: Container ichida app sekin, `docker stats` CPU 50% ko'rsatadi, lekin p99 latency yuqori. Nima tekshirasan?
questions.explanation: CPU quota throttling: --cpus limiti qisqa burst'larni 100ms davrda kesadi. cgroup cpu.stat nr_throttled ni ko'r. Fix: limitni oshir/olib tashla, runtime thread soni (GOMAXPROCS) limitga mos.

questions.question: Bir host'da 40 container, `docker ps` qotib qoldi, yangi container start bo'lmaydi. Qanday tekshirasan?
questions.explanation: Daemon holati: journalctl -u docker, disk/inode (df -h, df -i /var/lib/docker), PID limit, containerd. Ko'pincha disk to'la yoki log fayllar katta. Mitigate: joy bo'shatish, keyin root cause.

questions.question: BuildKit secret va cache mount'lar: `RUN --mount=type=secret` va `type=cache` nima beradi?
questions.explanation: secret mount — build vaqtida token/kalitni faqat bitta RUN uchun fayl sifatida beradi, image layer'iga va tarixga tushmaydi. cache mount — paket menejeri cache'ini (go mod, apt, npm) build'lar orasida saqlaydi, layer'ga kirmaydi — tez va kichik image.

questions.question: Image ichida nima borligini qanday tekshirasiz: `docker history`, `inspect`, `dive`?
questions.explanation: `docker history` — har layer qaysi instruksiya va hajm; `docker inspect` — config (ENV, CMD, user, label, digest); `dive` — layer'lar bo'yicha fayl tizimi va isrof qilingan joy. Secret yoki keraksiz fayl image'ga tushib qolganini aniqlash uchun.

questions.question: distroless va scratch image'lar: afzalliklari va debug qilish qiyinchiligi?
questions.explanation: scratch — bo'sh image (faqat statik binary); distroless — minimal runtime (CA sertifikatlar, tzdata, nonroot user), shell va paket menejeri yo'q. Kichik hajm, kam CVE, hujum yuzasi kichik. Debug: `kubectl debug --target`, `-debug` tag'li distroless variantlari.

questions.question: `docker save/load` va `docker export/import` farqi?
questions.explanation: save/load — image'ni barcha layer, tag va metadata bilan tar'ga (registry'siz ko'chirish, air-gapped muhit). export/import — **container**ning fayl tizimini tekis tar sifatida, tarix va CMD/ENV'siz.

questions.question: `docker inspect` va `docker stats`, `docker events` bilan ishlayotgan container haqida nima bilish mumkin?
questions.explanation: inspect — to'liq konfiguratsiya va holat (IP, mount'lar, restart soni, exit code, OOMKilled, health); stats — real vaqtdagi CPU/RAM/IO; events — Docker daemon hodisalari oqimi (start, die, oom, health_status).

questions.question: Docker daemon yoki dockerd restart bo'lganda container'lar to'xtamasligi uchun nima qilinadi (`live-restore`)?
questions.explanation: Default'da dockerd to'xtasa container'lar ham to'xtaydi. `"live-restore": true` — daemon yangilanish/restart paytida container'lar ishlashda davom etadi (containerd-shim ushlab turadi). Swarm rejimida ishlamaydi.

questions.question: Container ichida PID 1 bo'lish nimani anglatadi? Signal va zombie bilan bog'liq qanday maxsus qoidalar bor?
questions.explanation: PID 1 uchun kernel default signal handler'larni qo'llamaydi: handler o'rnatilmagan SIGTERM e'tiborsiz qoladi. PID 1 orphan process'larni reap qilishi ham shart.

questions.question: Docker image'ni qanday "reproducible" qilasiz: bir xil source'dan har safar bir xil digest?
questions.explanation: Base image'ni digest bilan pin, paket versiyalarini pin, timestamp'ni SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH bilan muzlatish, BuildKit rewrite-timestamp, lockfile.

questions.question: Container ichida Go servis CPU limit `--cpus=2` bilan, lekin host'da 64 core. Qanday muammo bor va qanday tuzatiladi?
questions.explanation: Go 1.25 gacha GOMAXPROCS host core soniga teng edi: 64 thread 2 core kvotasida CFS throttling va latency spike beradi. GOMAXPROCS'ni limitga moslash kerak.

questions.question: Docker registry pull rate limit yoki registry o'chishi production deploy'ni to'xtatdi. Qanday himoyalanasiz?
questions.explanation: Pull-through cache / mirror registry, image'larni o'z registry'ga ko'chirish (ECR/Harbor), digest pin, node'larda pre-pull. Tashqi registry critical path'da bo'lmasin.

questions.question: Kompaniya bo'ylab container image standartini qanday belgilaysiz (base image, scanning, signing, ownership)?
questions.explanation: Golden base image'lar (owned, patched), CI'da majburiy scan + SBOM + signing, admission'da policy (faqat imzolangan, ichki registry), patch SLA va ownership.

questions.question: Docker'dan containerd/Podman'ga o'tish (masalan K8s dockershim olib tashlangani) — qanday rejalashtirasiz?
questions.explanation: Image'lar OCI bo'lgani uchun o'zgarmaydi; o'zgaradigan narsa runtime'ga bog'liq joylar: docker.sock mount, DinD build, log format, monitoring agentlari, CLI skriptlar.

questions.question: Multi-tenant platformada boshqa jamoalarning ishonchsiz kodini container'da ishlatish kerak. runc yetarlimi?
questions.explanation: Yo'q: runc'da barcha container'lar bitta kernel'ni bo'lishadi, kernel CVE = escape. Ishonchsiz kod uchun gVisor/Kata/Firecracker, alohida node pool, qattiq seccomp.

questions.question: Image hajmi va cold start: 2 GB ML image'li servis autoscale paytida 3 daqiqada ko'tarilyapti. Nima qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Pull vaqti asosiy sabab. Image'ni bo'lish (model'ni alohida artifact), lazy pulling (stargz/SOCI), node'da pre-pull/cache, layer tartibi, zstd siqish.

questions.question: Container platformasini noldan loyihalashda build, distribute, run va observe qatlamlarida qaysi qarorlar eng qimmat (qaytarib bo'lmaydigan)?
questions.explanation: Qaytarib bo'lmaydiganlari: image identity modeli (digest + imzo), registry topologiyasi, multi-tenancy chegarasi (namespace vs cluster vs VM), runtime izolyatsiya darajasi. Tool tanlovi esa arzon o'zgaradi.

questions.question: "Hammasini container'ga o'tkazamiz" taklifi bor. Qaysi workload'lar container uchun yomon nomzod va qanday baholaysiz?
questions.explanation: Yomon nomzodlar: kernel/hardware'ga yaqin (DPDK, GPU driver), og'ir stateful DB (operatsion tajriba yo'q bo'lsa), litsenziya host'ga bog'liq, juda kam o'zgaradigan legacy. Baholash: qiymat (deploy tezligi, zichlik) vs xavf va operatsion narx.

questions.question: `docker run nginx` buyrug'i ostida nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: CLI → dockerd API → image yo'q bo'lsa pull → containerd → runc namespace/cgroup yaratib jarayonni ishga tushiradi → tarmoq va port ulanadi.

questions.question: Konteyner VM'dan qanday farq qiladi — ostida?
questions.explanation: Konteyner — host kernel'ini bo'lishuvchi oddiy Linux jarayoni (namespace + cgroup bilan ajratilgan). VM — o'z kernel'i bilan to'liq virtual mashina.

questions.question: Namespace va cgroup nima?
questions.explanation: Namespace — jarayon nimani KO'RADI (o'z PID, tarmoq, fayl tizimi). Cgroup — qancha RESURS ishlata oladi (CPU, RAM).

questions.question: Docker image layer'lari qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Dockerfile'dagi har o'zgartiruvchi qadam alohida read-only layer. Layer'lar cache'lanadi va image'lar orasida bo'lishiladi; konteyner ustiga yoziladigan yupqa qatlam qo'shiladi.

questions.question: `-p 8080:80` port mapping ostida qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Docker host'da iptables NAT (DNAT) qoidasi qo'shadi: host:8080 ga kelgan paket konteyner IP:80 ga yo'naltiriladi.

questions.question: `CMD` va `ENTRYPOINT` farqi?
questions.explanation: ENTRYPOINT — doim ishlaydigan asosiy buyruq. CMD — default argument'lar, `docker run` da oson almashtiriladi.

questions.question: `.dockerignore` nima uchun kerak?
questions.explanation: Build context'dan keraksiz fayllarni (`.git`, `node_modules`, `.env`) chiqaradi — build tez, image kichik, secret tushmaydi.

questions.question: Docker'da restart policy'lar?
questions.explanation: `no`, `on-failure[:N]`, `always`, `unless-stopped`.

questions.question: Konteyner ichiga qanday kirasiz va `exec` bilan `attach` farqi?
questions.explanation: `docker exec -it c sh` — yangi jarayon (shell) ochadi. `attach` — asosiy jarayon (PID 1) terminaliga ulanadi.

questions.question: Konteyner loglarini qanday ko'rasiz?
questions.explanation: `docker logs` — konteynerning stdout/stderr'i.

questions.question: Docker tarmoq turlari: bridge, host, none?
questions.explanation: bridge — default, izolyatsiya + NAT. host — host tarmog'ini to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishlatadi. none — tarmoqsiz.

questions.question: Ikki konteyner bir-biri bilan nom orqali qanday gaplashadi?
questions.explanation: Bitta user-defined network'ga ulang — Docker ichki DNS konteyner nomini IP'ga aylantiradi.

questions.question: Image tag va digest farqi?
questions.explanation: Tag (`nginx:1.27`) — o'zgaruvchan nom. Digest (`sha256:...`) — mazmunning o'zgarmas hash'i.

questions.question: `latest` tag'ning muammosi nima?
questions.explanation: "Eng yangi" degani emas — shunchaki default nom. Qaysi versiya ishlayotganini bilib bo'lmaydi, rollback qiyin.

questions.question: Image hajmini kichraytirish usullari?
questions.explanation: Kichik base (alpine, slim, distroless), multi-stage build, keraksiz fayl va cache'ni o'chirish, `.dockerignore`.

questions.question: Konteynerni root bo'lmagan foydalanuvchi bilan ishga tushirish?
questions.explanation: Dockerfile'da `USER` qo'shing — konteynerdan qochish (escape) holatida zarar kamayadi.

questions.question: `HEALTHCHECK` nima?
questions.explanation: Docker konteyner ichidagi ilova sog'lomligini davriy tekshiradi; status `healthy`/`unhealthy`.

questions.question: Konteynerning exit code'lari nimani bildiradi (0, 1, 137, 143)?
questions.explanation: 0 — normal, 1 — ilova xatosi, 137 — SIGKILL (ko'pincha OOM), 143 — SIGTERM bilan to'xtatilgan.

questions.question: Docker disk joyini qanday tozalaysiz?
questions.explanation: `docker system df` bilan ko'rish, `docker system prune` bilan tozalash.

questions.question: Konteynerga resurs limitini qanday qo'yasiz?
questions.explanation: `--memory` va `--cpus` flag'lari (cgroup orqali).

questions.question: `docker cp` nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: Host va konteyner orasida fayl nusxalaydi (konteyner ishlamayotgan bo'lsa ham).

questions.question: Environment variable'larni konteynerga berish usullari?
questions.explanation: `-e KEY=val`, `--env-file .env`, Dockerfile'da `ENV`.

questions.question: `docker build -t` va build context nima?
questions.explanation: `-t` — image nomi va tag. Context — `docker build` ga berilgan papka (odatda `.`), COPY faqat shu ichidan oladi.

questions.question: Docker daemon va Docker CLI farqi?
questions.explanation: CLI (`docker`) — mijoz. Daemon (`dockerd`) — konteynerlarni haqiqatda boshqaradigan server, socket orqali gaplashadi.

questions.question: Rootless Docker va Podman nima?
questions.explanation: Daemon'ni root'siz ishlatish. Podman — daemon'siz, rootless, Docker'ga mos CLI.

questions.question: Docker volume'ni qanday backup qilasiz?
questions.explanation: Vaqtinchalik konteyner bilan volume'ni mount qilib, `tar` bilan arxivlash.

questions.question: Dockerfile'da `WORKDIR` nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: Keyingi RUN/COPY/CMD uchun joriy papkani belgilaydi (yo'q bo'lsa yaratadi).

questions.question: `EXPOSE` portni ochadimi?
questions.explanation: Yo'q — faqat hujjat (metadata). Port `-p` bilan publish qilinadi.

questions.question: Dockerfile'da layer cache qachon buziladi?
questions.explanation: Qadam yoki undan oldingi biror qadam o'zgarsa, keyingi barcha qadamlar qayta bajariladi. COPY uchun — fayllar mazmuni o'zgarsa.

questions.question: Docker Hub rate limit nima va qanday yechiladi?
questions.explanation: Anonim pull'lar soni cheklangan. Yechim: login qilish, mirror/proxy cache, o'z registry'ingiz.

questions.question: Image'dagi zaifliklarni qanday tekshirasiz?
questions.explanation: Scanner: Trivy, Grype, Docker Scout. CI'da build'dan keyin.

questions.question: `docker stop` va `docker kill` farqi?
questions.explanation: `stop` — SIGTERM, 10 soniya kutadi, keyin SIGKILL. `kill` — darhol SIGKILL.

questions.question: Konteyner nega darhol to'xtab qoladi (`Exited (0)`)?
questions.explanation: Asosiy jarayon (PID 1) tugadi. Konteyner faqat PID 1 ishlayotgan vaqtgacha yashaydi.

questions.question: Docker'da `--rm` qachon ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Bir martalik konteyner tugagach avtomatik o'chirilsin uchun.

questions.question: Bitta konteynerda bir nechta jarayon (nginx + app) ishlatish yaxshimi?
questions.explanation: Odatda yo'q — bitta konteyner, bitta asosiy jarayon. Log, restart, scale alohida bo'ladi.

questions.question: Docker log driver'lari va log rotate?
questions.explanation: Default `json-file`; boshqalari `local`, `journald`, `syslog`, `fluentd`, `awslogs`. Rotate — `max-size`, `max-file`.

questions.question: Docker ma'lumotlari hostda qayerda saqlanadi?
questions.explanation: `/var/lib/docker` — image layer'lar, konteynerlar, volume'lar.
